skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply auditing principles to assess financial statements and risks.
Identify and evaluate inherent and control risks in financial processes.
Assess the effectiveness of internal controls in mitigating risks.
Use analytical techniques to detect potential material misstatements.
Develop and implement audit procedures based on identified risks.
Gather evidence to support audit conclusions and financial statements.
Prepare audit reports and management letters based on audit findings.
Apply audit findings to improve client's financial reporting processes.
Adhere to laws, regulations, and ethical standards in audit engagements.
Effectively communicate audit results and management issues to stakeholders.
